en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor convicted of unlawful sex with underage girl
en.dek: Sei Chun-hing was found guilty of having sexual intercourse with a 13-year-old in 2011 and remanded in custody; he was acquitted of an earlier indecent assault charge.
body: Yuen Long District Councillor Sei Chun-hing was convicted in the District Court on Monday of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16 and immediately remanded in custody pending sentence.

Judge Stanley Chan Kwong-chi found Sei guilty of the charge relating to an incident on 14 March 2011 in a Tin Shui Wai flat when the girl was 13. He was acquitted of a separate indecent assault allegation from 2008 involving the same complainant when she was 11.

The court heard that Sei had met the girl while assisting as a drama instructor at her primary school. The case was adjourned to 27 October for a victim impact report and sentencing. Sei had denied both charges.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施駿興與未成年女童非法性交罪成 還押候判
zh.dek: 區域法院周一裁定施駿興一項與16歲以下女童非法性交罪成，即時還押；另一項非禮罪則不成立。
body: 元朗區議員施駿興周一在區域法院被裁定一項與年齡在16歲以下女童非法性交罪成立，法官陳廣池即時將他還押，案件押後至10月27日聽取求情及判刑。
法官裁定施駿興在2011年3月14日於天水圍單位與當時13歲女事主非法性交的控罪成立，但就2008年涉及同一事主的非禮控罪則裁定不成立。
控方案情指，施駿興早年任小學話劇導師助手時認識事主。施否認兩項控罪。
